description: Macro indicators by country and year: GDP, real GDP growth, GDP per capita, inflation, unemployment, population, government debt and current account, side by side from the World Bank (WDI actuals) and the IMF World Economic Outlook (DataMapper, incl. projections). Up to 10 countries (ISO2/ISO3) and 8 indicators per call. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/macro-indicators

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes, comma-separated (max 10), e.g. US,DEU,JP

indicators.description: Comma list from: gdp, gdp_growth, gdp_per_capita, inflation, unemployment, population, government_debt, current_account (default gdp,gdp_growth,inflation,unemployment)

to.description: Last year (default current year; IMF projections up to +5)
